correctness.rationale: The complete statement fixes a stable finite periodic linear Gaussian car-following system with zero velocity alignment and centered fluctuation energy. Unit Fourier mode q has drift polynomial lambda^2+gamma lambda+alpha*2(1-cos q)+(gamma/T)*(1-e^{iq}); a purely imaginary root can occur only at d_q=alpha+gamma/(2T)-(1+cos q)/(2T^2)=0. Ito moment balance gives gap power C/d_q, speed power C[1+(1+cos q)/(2T^2 d_q)] (C=sigma^2/(2gamma)); Parseval for N=3 yields H=sigma^2/(12gamma)+sigma^2*(2alpha+gamma/(2T))/(6gamma*d), d=alpha+gamma/(2T)-1/(4T^2), derivative sigma^2*(gamma*T-1)/(12gamma*T^2*d^2). Thus all stable stiffnesses have the asserted energy sign while speed and gap variances fall. The mode q=0 velocity OU is included; equality and stability boundary are explicitly handled. A separately constructed rational 5-by-5 drift Lyapunov solve, after correcting its initial indexing mistake, matched all G/K/H formulae for four parameter tuples including the exact increasing-energy witness alpha 0 versus 1. Finite checks corroborate, analytic mode calculation proves N>=3.
